analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape was a no-catalyst yen and franc bid: JPY led at +0.208% and CHF +0.078%, both closing at their best, while commodity FX lagged with NZD -0.166% and AUD -0.123%. USD attempted a +0.12% gain but gave back 100% to close -0.033%. No economic release cleanly owned the majors; RBA Bullock and RBNZ Breman were muted, and NZ inflation expectations lacked a forecast to score.

themes.theme: JPY/CHF safe-haven bid on no hard catalyst
themes.evidence: JPY strength +0.208% and CHF +0.078%, both closed at their best with no own releases.
NZD -0.166% and AUD -0.123%; NZD inflation expectations unscored (2.36% actual, no forecast) and RBNZ Breman muted.
USD led +0.12% intraday then gave back 100%, closing -0.033%; DXY -0.086%.

scenarios.name: JPY/CHF bid extends
scenarios.thesis: The no-news bid in JPY and CHF persists as risk sentiment stays fragile; commodity FX remains offered and USD stays heavy.
triggers: USD/JPY holds below its close of 159.12 and makes fresh session lows
A fresh risk-negative headline amplifies CHF/JPY demand
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers above its overnight range midpoint and AUD/USD closes back above 0.67403

pair_paths.rationale: JPY closed at its best, strongest major, no catalyst to reverse the bid.
CHF second strongest and closed at its best with no own releases.
AUD weak at -0.123% with a muted RBA speech, no positive driver.

scenarios.name: Mean reversion in commodity FX
scenarios.thesis: Oversold AUD and NZD bounce as no fresh negative catalyst emerges, and USD stays offered after its rejected attempt.

NZD/USD closed in upper half of range (close_in_range 0.68), short-covering risk.
